title: Sloth waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="26" ry="22" fill="#B8874A"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="20" ry="17" fill="#D4A96A"/>
  <!-- Claws on left arm -->
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="60" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#8B6914" transform="rotate(-20 24 60)"/>
  <!-- Left arm (hanging down) -->
  <path d="M30 58 Q22 72 28 82" stroke="#B8874A" stroke-width="9" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Right arm (waving up) -->
  <path d="M70 55 Q82 38 78 24" stroke="#B8874A" stroke-width="9" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Right hand/claws -->
  <circle cx="78" cy="22" r="6" fill="#D4A96A"/>
  <ellipse cx="76" cy="15" rx="2.5" ry="4" fill="#8B6914" transform="rotate(-15 76 15)"/>
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="14" rx="2.5" ry="4" fill="#8B6914" transform="rotate(5 80 14)"/>
  <ellipse cx="83" cy="16" rx="2.5" ry="4" fill="#8B6914" transform="rotate(20 83 16)"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="22" ry="20" fill="#B8874A"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="17" ry="15" fill="#D4A96A"/>
  <!-- Face mask (lighter) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="45" rx="13" ry="11" fill="#F0D9B0"/>
  <!-- Eye patches (dark but lit) -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="42" rx="7" ry="6" fill="#6B4A1A"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="42" rx="7" ry="6" fill="#6B4A1A"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="42" r="3" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="42" r="3" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="41" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="41" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M45 52 Q50 56 55 52" stroke="#5C3A1E" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="38" r="5" fill="#B8874A"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="38" r="5" fill="#B8874A"/>
  <!-- Belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="12" ry="10" fill="#E8C88A"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="88" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#8B6914"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="88" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#8B6914"/>
</svg>
